title: A short chuckle before laughter fills out
summary: When someone tries to amuse them, most children chuckle, not yet a full giggle, by about 4 months, the milestone sheet says.
body: sheet splits the sound in two. At 4 months the entry is a chuckle while a person tries to be amusing. A full giggle is a later entry, at 6 months. The split is the point of this card. The publisher means most children, a share it puts at 75 percent or higher, and a child who only chuckles later is not given a condition.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Chuckles (not yet a full laugh) when you try to make him laugh'.
